explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 unless the agent chose a1, reached S1 by a common transition, the previous trial was also a1 to S1 common, and that previous trial went unrewarded; then the value is about 9-10 late in the episode (trials 65-85) and about 3-4 earlier. It is 3-4 at the D2 of the next a1 to S1 common trial right after such a peak even if that trial predecessor was rewarded, and 0 whenever a2, any rare transition or a rewarded streak came just before.
